status: authored deterministic qualitative rules; no calibrated diagnosis

rules.R_ZERO_UNIT: Correct zero count/value gives limited evidence about nonzero place value; retain uncertainty and use a session-unseen nonzero item if inspection is needed.
rules.R_AMBIGUOUS: Ambiguous original digit/count wording or value/count responses support wording uncertainty only; no mathematical gap is inferred.
rules.R_UNIT: Explicit incompatible count/value on a clear unit probe supports unit difficulty; correct paired count/value challenges it with declared reasoning strength.
rules.R_EQ: Wrong explicit tens equivalence supports difficulty on that prerequisite; a correct relation challenges it, with bare success weaker than reasoned success.
rules.R_COMBINE: Wrong combining can support combine difficulty only after independent equivalence is demonstrated; otherwise retain unknown cause.
rules.R_CONSERVE: A complete explicit representation changing total value supports bookkeeping/conservation difficulty; partial answers do not establish it.
rules.R_APPLY: Incorrect full exchange after independently demonstrated prerequisites supports coordination difficulty; full unassisted correct exchange challenges it.
rules.R_WORDING: Improvement after explicit-unit restatement is evidence compatible with a wording mismatch, not certainty about cause.
rules.R_SLIP: An unassisted reasoned correction after neutral check can support a possible slip; distinct repeated coherent errors challenge that interpretation.
rules.R_UNKNOWN: Unknown cause always remains available; ambiguous/unparsed/mixed observations are inconclusive about specific mechanisms.

assistance: Every link preserves event assistance; engine additionally partitions concept-specific exposure and time. Assisted challenges cannot erase earlier unassisted supports.
